scope: offline interpretation of the accepted BLS CPI-U raw XLSX and one World Bank WDI USA/Canada GDP comparison

tasks.task_card: Identify publisher, series, frequency, period range, freshness, missing-versus-zero semantics, and report absent metadata as unknown.

answer.series_context: CPI-U, as scoped by the accepted F evidence; the workbook does not include a descriptive official series title.
answer.freshness: FRESH in the recorded export evidence; this is a point-in-time status, not a continuing freshness guarantee.
answer.missing_zero_semantics: No missing or zero observations were found in this workbook. Missing values remain distinct from numeric zero and must not be replaced with zero.

tasks.task_card: Identify countries, shared indicator, unit, period alignment, comparison policy, and interpretation limits.

answer.unit_basis: Exact source/dataset/indicator mapping supported by the reviewed World Bank source metadata and its source note.
answer.freshness: Both inputs were FRESH in the recorded export evidence; the annual fallback is not a World Bank publication-lag guarantee.
answer.alignment_and_transformations: The workbook aligns only the shared typed period 2024. It applies no aggregation, conversion, interpolation, or forward-fill; missing values remain blank.
answer.interpretation_limits: This is nominal GDP in current U.S. dollars. It does not establish real GDP, PPP, per-capita GDP, welfare, or cross-provider equivalence.

limitations: This simulation demonstrates AI interpretation of the two accepted artifacts only; it does not demonstrate human analyst usability or support for other providers and series.
The BLS workbook omits a descriptive series title and has blank dataset, unit, and currency fields; these were reported as unknown rather than inferred.
The measured 41.7 ms covers local preflight only. AI response time and end-to-end analyst time were not measured.
